التحموا (form VIII)
# اِلْتَحَمُوا (iltaḥamū) /il.ta.ħa.muː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِلْتَحَمَ (iltaḥama)
# اُلْتُحِمُوا (ultuḥimū) /ul.tu.ħi.muː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِلْتَحَمَ (iltaḥama)
# اِلْتَحِمُوا (iltaḥimū) /il.ta.ħi.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِلْتَحَمَ (iltaḥama)
